parameters.content:
## 1. Receive and check
The form or portal posts the lead here with the shared secret (X-Lead-Secret header, or ?key=). Wrong secret: 401 and an alert. No usable phone or email: 400. Otherwise 202 right away and the work goes on.

## 2. Duplicates
monday is searched by phone and email. The same lead within DEDUPE_HOURS gets a note on its existing item and is not routed or texted again.

## 3. Assign and text the lead
Round robin picks the next agent who is not away. The monday item is created first, with an idempotency key, so two copies of one submission cannot both get through (if monday stays busy with the key, the run stops and asks for a check). Then the lead gets the instant text with the agent's name.

## 4. Classify and alert the agent
Claude sorts the lead through a forced tool call: intent, budget, timeline, area, pre-approval, urgency and a one line summary. If Claude fails, keyword rules fill in. The details go to monday and the agent gets a text with the link.

## 5. Timer and flags
Starts the escalation timer as its own run. If anything went wrong (Claude down, a text or a save failed, no agent free), the run ends as failed so the error workflow posts the details to Slack.

## 6. Escalation
Runs ESCALATION_MINUTES later, or that long after quiet hours end. Still New with the same agent: reassign to the next agent who is not away, text them and alert the broker in Slack. If the agent changed the status, nothing happens.

parameters.errorMessage: Lead webhook call rejected: the X-Lead-Secret header (or ?key=) is missing or wrong. If real leads land here, check LEAD_WEBHOOK_SECRET in n8n and in your form or portal.

parameters.responseBody: {"ok": false, "error": "a valid phone number or email is required"}

parameters.errorMessage: ={{ 'monday did not save the repeat submission on item ' + $('Check Duplicate').item.json.existing.id + ' (' + $('Check Duplicate').item.json.existing.url + '). Error: ' + ($json.error ? $json.error.message : JSON.stringify($json.errors || $json)).slice(0, 300) }}

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ query: 'query ReadLead($item: [ID!], $cols: [String!]) { items(ids: $item) { id name state url column_values(ids: $cols) { id text value } } }', variables: { item: [$json.escalation.itemId], cols: [$json.escalation.statusColumn, $json.escalation.agentColumn] } }) }}
